description:
VCog-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs on Abstract Visual Reasoning
	


	
		
		Description:
	

VCog-Bench is a publicly available zero-shot abstract visual reasoning (AVR) benchmark designed to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This benchmark integrates two well-known AVR datasets from the AI community and includes a newly proposed MaRs-VQA dataset. reputation: Recognized in the multimodal community as a targeted zero-shot benchmark for abstract visual reasoning; used to highlight limitations of current MLLMs on AVR tasks.
